app_cleartext_body_available: Passwords and data can be read on the network. This server also speaks HTTPS on the same port.
app_cleartext_body_unavailable: Passwords and data can be read on the network. Turn on HTTPS, or put an HTTPS reverse proxy in front.
app_cleartext_fingerprint: Certificate fingerprint to compare with your browser's: {fingerprint}
deviceform_channelcheck_checking: Checking that machines can reach the encrypted agent channel…
deviceform_channelcheck_compose: In docker-compose.yml, under ports:, add "{mapping}", then run docker compose up -d.
deviceform_channelcheck_disabled: The encrypted agent channel is off on this server (DUMBMONIT_AGENT_LISTEN=off): agents use the web port.
deviceform_channelcheck_dns_body: The server cannot resolve {host}, so machines may not either. Open this page with the address machines use to reach the server.
deviceform_channelcheck_error: The agent channel could not be checked
deviceform_channelcheck_firewall: Then open TCP port {port} on the server's firewall (firewalld, ufw or Windows):
deviceform_channelcheck_hairpin: The check runs from the server itself: behind a NAT without hairpin it can fail although machines outside connect fine.
deviceform_channelcheck_refused_body: The server could not reach its own agent channel at {address}: the connection was refused. Agents would fail the same way.
deviceform_channelcheck_relay_firewall: Open TCP port {port} on {relay}'s firewall so the site's machines can reach it:
deviceform_channelcheck_relay_ready: {relay} listens on port {port}: the site's machines reach the server through it.
deviceform_channelcheck_relay_waiting: Waiting for {relay} to open its gateway on port {port} (at its next report, within a minute)…
deviceform_channelcheck_timeout_body: Nothing answered at {address} within 5 seconds: a firewall probably drops the traffic, or the address is wrong.
deviceform_channelcheck_tls_body: Something other than the DumbMonit agent channel answers at {address}. Check that port {port} leads to the DumbMonit container.
deviceform_channelcheck_tls_title: Port {port} answers, but not as the agent channel
settings_agentupdates_blocked_body: The agent binaries shipped with this server carry no signature, and agents only install an update whose signature matches the release key compiled into them. Nothing is offered until that changes.
settings_agentupdates_blocked_fix_dev: For development only: accept unsigned builds below. Whoever can change the server's binaries could then run code on every agent.
settings_agentupdates_blocked_fix_manual: Or update agents by hand: run the install command again on each machine.
settings_agentupdates_blocked_fix_signed: Run a signed release image: once the release signing key is set up, every build is signed.
settings_agentupdates_hint_unsigned: This server's agent build is not signed: agents only install signed updates.
settings_https_description: The certificate of the web port, the redirect to HTTPS, and every connection that still travels in clear.
settings_https_disabled: HTTPS is turned off (DUMBMONIT_TLS=off): the web port serves plain HTTP only.
settings_https_finding_agents_legacy: The plain agent channel is still accepted (agents using it: {count}). Require mTLS in Settings › Agents.
settings_https_finding_channel_http: {subject}: notifications are sent over plain HTTP.
settings_https_finding_credentials_over_: {subject}: credentials are sent over plain HTTP.
settings_https_finding_https_unavailable: HTTPS is not available on the web port.
settings_https_finding_ldap_plain: The LDAP directory is reached without TLS (ldap:// without StartTLS): passwords travel in clear.
settings_https_finding_ldap_unverified: The LDAP directory's certificate is not verified.
settings_https_finding_local_backup: Local backups ({subject}) keep the database and secret.key side by side: keep that folder as private as /data.
settings_https_finding_oidc_http: The OpenID Connect provider is reached over plain HTTP.
settings_https_finding_redirect_off: Plain-HTTP visits are not sent to HTTPS: turn on the redirect above.
settings_https_finding_saml_http: The SAML sign-in page is on plain HTTP.
settings_https_finding_self_signed: The certificate is self-signed: browsers warn, and only the fingerprint proves it is this server.
settings_https_finding_smtp_plain: {subject}: SMTP without TLS, messages and the password travel in clear.
settings_https_finding_snmp_community: {subject}: SNMP v1/v2c sends its community in clear. Prefer SNMP v3 with privacy (authPriv).
settings_https_finding_snmp_no_privacy: {subject}: SNMP v3 without privacy, data is not encrypted. Use authPriv.
settings_https_finding_tls_unverified: {subject}: the TLS certificate is not verified.
settings_https_finding_unsigned_updates: Unsigned agent builds are accepted for updates.
settings_https_finding_victoria_http: The external VictoriaMetrics ({subject}) is reached over plain HTTP.
settings_https_findings_intro: These settings were chosen and keep working; each line says where secrets or data travel in clear or without certificate checks.
settings_https_findings_none: Nothing: every connection this server makes or receives is encrypted and verified.
settings_https_hsts: HTTPS responses carry Strict-Transport-Security ({value}): browsers then refuse plain HTTP for this address.
settings_https_load_error: HTTPS settings could not be loaded
settings_https_page_direct: This page: HTTPS straight to the server.
settings_https_page_plain: This page: plain HTTP, readable by anyone on the network.
settings_https_page_proxy: This page: HTTPS through a trusted reverse proxy.
settings_https_redirect_forced: Set by DUMBMONIT_HTTPS_REDIRECT in the environment: change it there.
settings_https_redirect_help: A browser that opens the interface over plain HTTP is sent to HTTPS on the same address and port. Requests through a reverse proxy, the API, install scripts, metrics and status pages are never redirected.
settings_https_reload_error: The provided certificate could not be reloaded: the previous one is still served
settings_https_save_error: The redirect could not be changed
settings_https_search_kw: https tls ssl certificate encryption cleartext hsts redirect fingerprint
settings_https_self_signed_help: Browsers warn once about a self-signed certificate: check that the fingerprint they show is this one. To avoid the warning, provide your own certificate (DUMBMONIT_TLS_CERT and DUMBMONIT_TLS_KEY) or trust this one on your workstations.
settings_https_unavailable: No certificate is loaded: the web port serves plain HTTP only.
